args.description: A small square castle bailey seen from directly above: a grey stone curtain wall with square corner turrets and a gate on the near side, enclosing a COMPLETELY EMPTY open courtyard of pale flagstones. The middle must be bare, flat and unobstructed with nothing standing in it — no keep, no tower, no buildings, no people inside the walls. Only the wall ring and the empty paved yard it encloses.

An open-air medieval blacksmith's workshop seen from above: a timber post-and-beam canopy with an open shingled lean-to roof on four corner posts and NO WALLS, sheltering a dark iron anvil on a block and a stone forge hearth with glowing orange coals. A rack of tools and a quench barrel beside it. Open on every side so the anvil and fire are plainly visible from above.
